crossRefs.note: Don’t be hasty to go out of his presence. Don’t persist in an evil thing, for he does whatever pleases him,
She fell at his feet, and said, “On me, my lord, on me be the blame! Please let your servant speak in your ears. Hear…
By patience a ruler is persuaded. A soft tongue breaks the bone.

translations.web: If the spirit of the ruler rises up against you, don’t leave your place; for gentleness lays great offenses to rest.
translations.bsb: If the ruler’s temper flares against you, do not abandon your post, for calmness lays great offenses to rest.
translations.kjv: If the spirit of the ruler rise up against thee, leave not thy place; for yielding pacifieth great offences.
translations.asv: If the spirit of the ruler rise up against thee, leave not thy place; for gentleness allayeth great offences.
